events.factual_description: Blue Note Tokyo presents Anoushka Shankar for her first appearance at the club on October 9-11, 2026. The October 9 performances start at 6:00 PM and 8:30 PM; the October 10-11 performances start at 4:30 PM and 7:30 PM. The announced quartet is Shankar on sitar, Sarathy Korwar on drums, Tom Farmer on bass and Arun Ghosh on clarinet. Blue Note Tokyo frames the engagement around Shankar's fusion of Indian classical tradition with contemporary and cross-genre practice and highlights Chapter III: We Return to Light as her current project context.

recommended_listening.title: Chapter III: We Return to Light (feat. Alam Khan & Sarathy Korwar) - EP

provenance.note: Dates, date-specific set times, first-Blue-Note-Tokyo context, announced quartet and reservation path were verified on Blue Note Tokyo's exact event page. Recommended listening is an exact Apple Music release page.

en.why_it_matters: This is a rare fit between artist, band and room rather than a routine tour stop: Shankar brings the sitar into Blue Note Tokyo for the first time with Sarathy Korwar, Tom Farmer and Arun Ghosh, a compact ensemble built for rhythmic and improvisational exchange. Her language sits precisely at the border Listening Notes cares about, where deep instrumental identity and Indian classical lineage remain intact while jazz, electronics and contemporary composition reshape the frame.
en.trip_verdict: S within Greater Tokyo/Kanto. Protect a set if you are in Tokyo and cross the city for it; the first Blue Note Tokyo appearance and quartet context make the night substantially more interesting than a generic tour date. Strong trip anchor, but not by itself a reason to cross the Pacific.
en.listen_before: Chapter III: We Return to Light

es.why_it_matters: Aquí importa la combinación específica de artista, banda y sala, no una parada rutinaria de gira: Shankar lleva el sitar por primera vez a Blue Note Tokyo con Sarathy Korwar, Tom Farmer y Arun Ghosh, un ensamble compacto hecho para el intercambio rítmico e improvisatorio. Su lenguaje vive justo en la frontera que le interesa a Listening Notes, donde la identidad instrumental y el linaje de la música clásica india permanecen intactos mientras el jazz, la electrónica y la composición contemporánea cambian el marco.
es.trip_verdict: S dentro de Greater Tokyo/Kanto. Hay que proteger un set si estás en Tokio y cruzar la ciudad por él; el debut en Blue Note Tokyo y el formato de cuarteto hacen esta fecha bastante más interesante que una parada genérica de gira. Es un ancla fuerte para un viaje, aunque por sí sola no justifica cruzar el Pacífico.

events.subtitle: Jonathan Taylor Rush, conductor
events.factual_description: Wolf Trap presents Jon Batiste with the National Symphony Orchestra, conducted by Jonathan Taylor Rush, at the Filene Center on Friday, August 21, 2026 at 8:00 PM. Wolf Trap describes the collaboration as spanning jazz, classical, blues and R&B. At the August 17 check, the performance was sold out and the official event page offered a wait list.

provenance.note: Date, 8:00 PM time, Filene Center venue, National Symphony Orchestra collaboration, conductor and current sold-out/wait-list status were verified on Wolf Trap's exact event page.

en.why_it_matters: Batiste's strength is not simply that he can move between genres; it is that piano, improvisation, New Orleans language, pop instinct and orchestral thinking can coexist without one flattening the others. Putting that vocabulary against the National Symphony Orchestra makes this a specific DMV event rather than another Batiste tour stop, with enough scale and instrumental possibility to matter on its own terms.
en.trip_verdict: S local/regional. Protect the night and join the official wait list if admission matters to you; this one-off Batiste–NSO setting is worth a dedicated DMV outing, but do not build travel around it unless a ticket actually clears.

es.why_it_matters: La fuerza de Batiste no consiste simplemente en moverse entre géneros; consiste en hacer convivir piano, improvisación, lenguaje de Nueva Orleans, instinto pop y pensamiento orquestal sin que una cosa aplaste a las otras. Poner ese vocabulario frente a la National Symphony Orchestra convierte la fecha en un acontecimiento específico del DMV y no en otra parada de gira, con suficiente escala y posibilidad instrumental para importar por sí misma.
es.trip_verdict: S local/regional. Hay que proteger la noche y entrar a la lista de espera oficial si te interesa la entrada; este formato Batiste–NSO de una sola noche merece una salida dedicada en el DMV, pero no conviene construir un viaje alrededor de él mientras no se libere boleto.
